dedupe_keys.name: nyc buildings subject to hpd jurisdiction

description: The registry of multiple dwellings and other buildings under the jurisdiction of the New York City Department of Housing Preservation and Development, published on NYC Open Data. A building appears if HPD required the owner to register it under the Housing Maintenance Code, started a litigation action, received a complaint, started a work order for emergency repair, demolition or the Alternative Enforcement Program, or added the property to that program. Each building has a BuildingID, borough, address, block, lot, building identification number, community board, census tract, management program, Department of Buildings class, legal stories, count of class A and B units, registration ID, life cycle and record status. The portal lists it as first public in 2014 and updated monthly, last on 12 August 2026. Coverage: New York City. Licence: not stated in the dataset metadata; free access through the portal or API. Caveats: it holds legal classifications, not structural or energy data, and covers only buildings that meet the criteria above. Useful as an asset inventory of housing stock for exposure and capacity planning, and it is a companion to the complaints dataset in the catalogue, joined by BuildingID.
